integrity: Analytic angular and radial inequalities are the basis of universal correctness; symbolic and numerical checks are supplementary. Originality is literature-relative; no independent audit has occurred.
limitations: The symmetric sixth-order determinant for odd normalized Janowski-starlike functions, real -1<=B<A<=1, complex coefficients. The theorem does not optimize a Hermitian determinant, a lower modulus, or a higher order.
title: Sharp complex Janowski sixth-order symmetric Toeplitz bound
